name: Banh dau xanh
summary: Bánh đậu xanh Hội An, on the 16 Apr 2024 Da Nang page, is a gift cake whose mung-bean filling is made with pork. The page calls that filling sweet, salty, and rich, and the dried cake crisp. A meatless cake is also made.
origin: Hội An, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page, which also calls it a childhood snack for people who live there.
taste: The pork filling is sweet, salty, and rich on the 16 Apr 2024 page. The dried cake is crisp. Eat it with hot tea, which is the pairing the page names.
howToEat: Eat the dried cake with a cup of hot tea. Ask for the meatless cake if you do not eat pork.
where: Hội An. The 16 Apr 2024 page does not name a street. Check on arrival.
